title: Okinawa, Tohoku Named Must-Visits for 2027
paragraphs: Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka are the most popular places in Japan for foreign tourists. But now, a famous travel guide is telling visitors to go somewhere different. Two areas of Japan, Okinawa and Tohoku, have been included on Lonely Planet's list of the best places to visit in 2027.

Every year, the travel guide company Lonely Planet publishes a list called Best in Travel. The 2027 list was released in September 2026, and it includes 50 recommendations: 25 destinations and 25 experiences. According to Lonely Planet, its writers and editors have visited every place on the list. The Red Centre of Australia was at the top of the list, and the United States had the most places, with seven.

Okinawa is a group of islands in the far south of Japan. It is very different from the rest of the country. It has blue water, white beaches, coral reefs and forests. Its culture is also special. For hundreds of years, it was the Ryukyu Kingdom, and it had close connections with China and Southeast Asia. Visitors can see historic places, visit traditional villages and try local food. Besides the main island, there are also smaller islands, such as Ishigaki and Iriomote.

Tohoku is in the north of Honshu, Japan's largest island, and it is made up of six prefectures. It is known for its mountains, countryside, festivals, hot springs and beautiful winter views. Lonely Planet chose the Michinoku Coastal Trail in Tohoku as one of its experiences. This long walking trail follows the Pacific coast, so visitors can explore the area on foot. The trail goes through many towns that were hit by the big earthquake and tsunami in 2011.
Both places are much less crowded than Tokyo and Kyoto, so they may be good choices for travelers who want something different.
